verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.gumloop.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured markdown index of doc pages. The docs themselves are served as raw .md URLs (index.md, core-concepts/agents.md, the API reference pages), so an agent can be pointed straight at the llms.txt index or at clean markdown pages. Missing for 10: any evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on agent-oriented doc consumption.
